Subject: ESCALATION: Approval requested - QuartzAI 45k token add + 45-day POC extension

Aditya / Vivek —

Requesting quick exec approval for a non-standard POC extension for QuartzAI (deal QZ-2026-4371). Summary below and attached files.

Why: Their evaluation shows clear early product/metric signal; engineering consumed credits due to a larger ingestion that was part of planned tuning. Losing momentum for 4–6 weeks risks the deal slipping.

Ask: One-time 45,000 token credit + 45-day POC extension beyond PLG limits. No upfront contract required; we will convert to a paid Dedicated trial if they hit the milestone. I recommend the following guardrails:
- Extension window: 45 days max (calendar)
- Credit release gated: we release 25% initially, remaining 75% released upon passing the reliability benchmark in MAP v3 (see attached)
- Billing: allow invoice/PO delay for 30 days after extension ends

Commercial rationale: projected ARR $280k within 12 months if ML tuning completes and latency targets are met. This is a time-sensitive motion tied to Q3 pipeline.

Risks: precedent for one-off credit extensions; we should require an internal note in Deal Desk and a short post-mortem on estimated spend vs. benefit.

Attachments: poc-usage-report-Jun12.csv, mutual-action-plan-v3.pdf

Please advise approval or changes. Quick note in-thread is fine — we need a decision before next Tue 06/16 to keep their engineering sprint on schedule.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Finance and Deal Desk to log this as non-standard term under deal QZ-2026-4371. Please ensure the customer signs the acknowledgment PDF (I will ask legal to prepare a short addendum).
